verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents reusable Datasets of test cases and offline experiments run against them, via UI, SDK (`run_experiment`) and CI/CD, with side-by-side comparison of runs, so the offline-evaluation core is well covered. The evidence does not explicitly show adding production traces to a dataset; it only shows traces being captured and reviewed in annotation queues, so the curation step is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating dataset items from production traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dataset and experiment workflow.
